port._doc: The HTTP server listens on this port

keepAliveTimeout._doc: The time in milliseconds to wait for the next request before closing the connection

requestTimeout._doc: The time in milliseconds to wait for the request to be processed

bodyLimit._doc: The maximum size of the request body

jsonLimit._doc: The maximum size of the JSON request body

urlencodedLimit._doc: The maximum size of the URL-encoded request body

security._doc: Open ID Client configuration for Adlab Service in Okta

connection_url._doc: The URL of the MongoDB database

db_name._doc: The name of the MongoDB database

connect_timeout_ms._doc: The time in milliseconds to wait for a connection to be established

socket_timeout_ms._doc: The time in milliseconds to wait for a response from the server

base_url._doc: Base url of the Advportal service used for assets

turbo_base_url._doc: Base URL for Turbo EngageClick templateJson API

collection_name._doc: The name of the collection that stores the migration state

file_extension._doc: The file extension of the migration files

config-path._doc: the path to the service log config file

config-path-worker._doc: the path to the cluster worker service log config file

enabled._doc: toggles logging of v8 GC events

heartbeat-path._doc: Physical path of the file served by the service to indicate its health to the load balancer

count._doc: The number of workers to create in the multi-process cluster. 0 indicates no workers are created and all requests are handled by the main process. -1 creates workers equivalent to the number of CPUs on the local host

execArgv._doc: list of string arguments passed to each worker

base-path._doc: the base path to which sigsegv crash dumps are written
